describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a plain light background. Its body, head, and limbs are covered in long, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the legs and lighter on the muzzle and underside. The head is broad and bear-like with a blunt snout. A large, glossy, dark brown domed shell covers the entire back from the base of the neck to the rump, giving the dorsal side a hard, beetle-like appearance. The animal stands on four thick legs ending in clawed paws and has a small furry tail visible at the rear beneath the shell.

describe.description: A large quadrupedal mammal with dense shaggy brown fur shown in side view facing right. The body, head, ears, limbs and short rear tail are bear-like, with heavy furry legs ending in broad clawed paws. The head has a broad muzzle with a black nose and bears two dark pointed horns: a very long slender upcurved horn on the snout above the nostrils and a much smaller short horn on the forehead between the eyes. Covering the entire back from behind the head to the rump is a large glossy dark brown domed shell in two sections, the rear section with fine longitudinal grooves and the whole shell edged with a rim of small rectangular plates.
